name: cli-session-read-your-writes
body:
A read routed through a live session observes every buffered mutation at the point of admission, saved or pending. With the session absent, the read opens the database directly and returns the last saved state.

ACCEPTANCE:
- With a live session, `apg query` observes a node or edge accepted moments earlier and yet unsaved.
- With the session absent, the same query reads the last saved state from `db.lbug` without opening a session.
